headline: This release introduces the retro-terminal Glitch theme for BetterBags Next along with new animation settings and effect fixes.

entries.title: Glitch theme for BetterBags Next
entries.details: Adds the Glitch theme, styled as a retro terminal with CRT warm-up animations, phosphor green scanlines, HUD brackets, and falling digital rain. Includes new animation settings to toggle glitch effects and data rain.

entries.title: Visual effects freezing after hiding the UI
entries.details: Fixed an issue where BetterBags Next visual effects stopped animating after toggling the interface with Alt+Z.
